note: Attacker-controlled deflate bits decode into the distance value; distance symbols 30/31 map to s_dist_base[30]=s_dist_base[31]=0.
For distance symbol 30/31 the base is 0, so dist becomes 0.
13 extra bits are read; with all-zero extra bits dist stays 0.
The match is the first symbol of the block, so no output bytes have been written and dist_from_out_buf_start == 0.

Root cause: the guard only rejects dist > dist_from_out_buf_start. With dist == 0 and dist_from_out_buf_start == 0 the comparison is false, so the zero-distance match that reads from the never-written output buffer is not rejected.
pSrc resolves to pOut_buf_start + 0, i.e. the start of the uninitialized malloc'd output buffer.
The length-3 match copies bytes from pOut_buf_start while no output bytes were ever written; the loads read uninitialized heap and store them as decompressed output.
With TINFL_FLAG_COMPUTE_ADLER32 the Adler-32 accumulator is computed over the poisoned output bytes, poisoning r->m_check_adler32.
Sink: the conditional branch compares the uninitialized-derived Adler-32 value, which MemorySanitizer reports as use-of-uninitialized-value.
